cases.prompt: Inspect repository/calculator.mjs and quantity.test.mjs. Build an inline review of the bug with source evidence, prepare the smallest single-file fix, and prepare the exact named node-test recipe. Await approval; report only actual execution results.

Use actual Git status, diff and history in the granted repository to explain its merge conflict. Show both decisions in an inline diff and ask for a decision with persistent controls. Do not stage, commit or invent a resolution.
Prepare the exact node-test recipe for repository/fail.test.mjs. After user approval, display the actual exit and failure output. Preserve the intentionally failing file and never label it passing.

Import both research sources. Reconcile North and South shipment counts, explain the withdrawn South 11 claim and differing on-time definition. Publish reusable evidence data and an inline comparison with provenance.

Inspect the selected external SQLite database. Show task counts and prepare a transaction marking task 1 done with an exact expected changed-row count of 1. Explain approval and stale version behavior. Do not access harness storage.

Import the records JSON and both research documents, publish a common sourced dataset and create a chart plus evidence list sharing data bindings. Explain counts without treating synthesis as independent verification.

Inspect editable.pdf including its text, fields and limitations. Create a persistent form for fullName, consent and role. Ask the user for values, then prepare a new local PDF export; never email it or invent certificate signing.

Build a local PDF visual signature placement workflow for editable.pdf. Support typed or drawn marks on page 1 at an explicitly previewed location. Clearly state no certificate, OCR or email support; preserve the original and require approval for a new export.

Use sources/planning.md to build an editable budget and dependency plan. Show total cost, prerequisites, weekly volunteer capacity and feasible ordering. Inputs must persist and actions must return meaningful data to this thread.

From sources/planning.md build an interactive what-if planner for a 20 percent budget reduction and one volunteer becoming unavailable. Ask which scope to reduce, preserve the user's decision and show which source facts and assumptions drive the recommendation.

Read sources/novel.md. Generate a purpose-built interactive tidepool specimen custody handoff app as an isolated widget, with receiver/timestamp/source-note editing and meaningful submit action. Reuse source data, preserve edits through expand and remount, and checkpoint state. Do not fit this into a new fixed app screen.

Create a purpose-built interactive contradiction map from the two research sources as an isolated widget. Let the user link claims, annotate uncertainty and submit a synthesis decision back to the agent. Reuse sourced data and preserve edits through expansion and remount.
